subject: Cadence & escalation playbook for renewal - Pendo Labs
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@pendolabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Cadence & escalation playbook for renewal - Pendo Labs

Amanda —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we discussed, we want to kick off a short renewal & expansion handshake so we have clear owners, an escalation path, and QBR timing locked before the end of August. Attached is a first-pass timeline I sketched out (renewal_timeline_draft.xlsx). High-level asks:

- Confirm decision-maker and procurement contact for compressed timeline (we heard Diego may own procurement)
- Lock a QBR window (propose two 60-minute options below)
- Agree on any term change asks (seat/throughput vs. committed burst) so Legal can prepare the amendment

Proposed QBR slots (PST):
- Tue Aug 5 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu Aug 7 — 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00

If none of those work, please send 2–3 windows that do. I’ve looped in Marissa (AM), Rachel (Legal/price ops), and Ben (CS/ops) to capture commitments and run the mutual action plan.

Attachments: renewal_timeline_draft.xlsx (timeline + milestone owners)

Next steps I’ll own: combine your stakeholder roster, finalize the MAP, and send a calendar invite once we agree on a slot.

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@pendolabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Morales <diego.m@pendolabs.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cadence & escalation playbook for renewal - Pendo Labs

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear plan and the timeline. Quick answers from our side:

- Decision-maker: Diego Morales (VP Finance) will sign any amendment; I’m the day-to-day program lead.
- Procurement contact: Diego and I will coordinate procurement intake (Diego copied).
- Capacity ask: we expect a 2x burst for the holiday campaign (Nov 15–Dec 15); otherwise baseline stays the same.

QBR availability: Aug 5 at 15:00 PST works best for our exec leads (Amanda + Diego). If that slot is still free, please lock it.

We’ll need to review any term change language a week before the exec QBR so Diego can brief Finance. Also please include an ops runbook for the burst plan (who to ping if we see SLA degradation).

Thanks —
Amanda
Head of Growth, Pendo Labs
amanda.chen@pendolabs.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@pendolabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cadence & escalation playbook for renewal - Pendo Labs

Amanda / team —

Great — I’ll tentatively reserve Tue Aug 5, 15:00–16:00 PST on our side. Karthik, I updated the MAP with target owners and timelines and added a short note on pricing options (mutual_action_plan.md). Two operational notes:

1) If Pendo Labs confirms a 2x burst window in Nov, we can pre-allocate burst capacity under a short-term addendum (ops-led) to guarantee headroom. That will require a quick capacity forecast from Ben (see below).

2) If they want shortened termination windows or tiered commit, Legal will need ~5 business days to prepare the amendment language. Rachel, can you confirm turnaround?

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

---
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.md (draft MAP with owners & deadlines)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@pendolabs.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cadence & escalation playbook for renewal - Pendo Labs

Looping in operational details. Quick summary:

- For a 2x burst Nov 15–Dec 15 we recommend a reserved burst pool (one-off addendum) vs relying on autoscale to avoid cold-start latency for large parallel inference jobs.
- I’ve sketched a short ops runbook and alert tree: Pager (oncall@redwood.ops) -> CS escalation -> Account exec -> Engineering. Will add to the MAP.
- Would like a short call with Pendo infra (their SRE) during the QBR to confirm testing cadence. Diego, can you confirm who on your side will join?

Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Chen <amanda.chen@pendolabs.com>, Diego Morales <diego.m@pendolabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cadence & escalation playbook for renewal - Pendo Labs

Amanda / Diego —

Thanks for the quick responses and for confirming Aug 5, 15:00–16:00 PST. I’ll send the calendar invite and include the MAP + ops runbook as pre-reads (mutual_action_plan.md; renewal_timeline_draft.xlsx).

Action list before QBR (owners & dates):
- Pendo: confirm SRE attendee for ops testing (Diego) — by 2025-07-31
- Redwood: final MAP + pricing note (Marissa) — by 2025-07-31
- Redwood Legal: draft amendment language for burst addendum (Rachel) — by 2025-07-31
- Redwood Ops: formalize runbook & alert tree (Ben) — by 2025-07-31

If all owners hit those dates we’ll review the amendment and operational test plan at the QBR and (if approved) send a DocuSign addendum for signature the week after. HubSpot deal link: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/DW-77821

Confirming I’ll reserve the slot and circulate invite with the pre-reads by EOD tomorrow.

Best —
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
